problem: downloadUrl() appends ?dl=1, and dl changes exactly one response header: /api/shelf, /api/drive and /api/upload answer Content-Disposition: inline without it and attachment with it.

isFile() matched the ?dl=1 URL too, so cacheFirst stored it in FILES as a file of its own — a SECOND full copy of every file a teacher downloaded, differing from the copy the viewer had already stored in one header.

cacheFirst returned any hit before looking at the request's cache mode, so that copy's headers were frozen: after the routes learned each file's real name (commit 14a8f29), a browser that had already downloaded the file went on saving it under its Drive id, and fetch(url,{cache:'reload'}) could not get past the cache either. Only a URL that had never been seen could.
'שמירת התצוגה לאופליין' prefetches the BARE urls (app/shelf/page.tsx: withBase(i.file), no dl), so the duplicate was never the offline copy — only extra bytes.
change_detail: downloadVariant(): a ?dl=1 request is never stored and always goes to the network. Offline it falls back to the bare copy in FILES, re-headed to attachment by asAttachment() so the button still saves rather than opens.

cacheFirst(): honours the request's cache mode — reload / no-store / no-cache skip the hit, fetch with cache:'no-store', and replace the entry; force-cache / only-if-cached stay cache-first; a reload that cannot reach the network still returns the cached copy.
dropDownloadVariants() on activate: removes ?dl=1 entries already sitting in FILES. Not a FILES version bump — her offline material is bare-keyed and untouched.
